items.hyp: Abasomesa ba ADF, e Makad Mukibi, baakwatibwa okusasula ssente zaabwe.
items.ref: Bammemba ba Allied Democratic Forces babiri, Kakooza Ahmad ne Dada Mukibi bammiddwa looni.

items.hyp: Ofiisi ya Akusasula Akakwata ku nteekateeka ekitongole kya Kiteante era yeeyongera okukola enkola ya ADF tekyewuunyisa.
items.ref: Woofiisi ekola ku kunoonyereza n'okulondoola e Kitante eyali ekola ku kutabaganya enkola za ADF yali tekyakola.

items.hyp: Mu kiseera kino bwe kiba nti abantu ba gavumenti be baali bafuula okuba n'abantu abali ku ADF abali mu nsikozi.
items.ref: Mu kukola ne Gavumenti, obulamu bwabwe bubadde bwongedde okuteekebwa mu katyabaga okuva eri bannaabwe ba Allied Democratic Forces abakyali mu nsiko.

items.hyp: Baali bazannyonnyola nti abo abaali bafuula abalala nga Lyavaala, Zilyawulawo, Junju, Kasakya, Issa Twatera, Benon Musisibwa, Kagimu.
items.ref: Baayogera ku kufa kw'ekibwatukira okwa bannaabwe nga Lyavaale, Zilyawulawo, Junju, Kasakya, Issa Twatera, Benon Musisi, Kagimu.

items.hyp: Abamu ku bantu baali bawagira era abamu ku abo aba ADF baali bamanyi bawagira eby'okwerinda.
items.ref: Abamu ku bannaabwe battibwa mu ngeri etaategeerekeka era abamu ku baaliko abayeekera ba Allied Democratic Forces baatiisatiisa okuttukiza ebikolwa y'obutujju.

items.hyp: Mu Okitobba 2008 abakungu ba gavumenti baali balemererwa okwogera ku ngeri abavubuka abali ku ludda lwa ADF abavumirira gavumenti ey'okugoberera abo abali ku ludda lwe baali baweebwa.
items.ref: Mu Gwekkumi gwa 2008, abakulira ebitongole by'ebyokwerinda baasisinkana okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku nsonga y'abaliko abayeekera ba ADF balumiriza gavumenti okubakozesa.

items.hyp: Oyo aba ADF abaali bannabyabufuzi okuva mu kibiina ekyo abaali bannabyabufuzi okuva mu ggwanga olw'okuba gavumenti ebaddewo n'okubuzaabuzaayo.
items.ref: Abaaliko abayeekera ba Allied Democratic Forces baalumizizza gavumenti okubakozesa n'ebasuulawo nga tebasasudde.

items.hyp: Obulumbaganyi obwo obwakubwa mu Kampala mu Jjulaayi nga 11 bwatandika okukola ku bannabyabufuzi aba Al-Shabaab ab'ekibiina kya ADF ne Somalia.
items.ref: Obulumbanyi bwa bbomu obwali mu Kampala nga 11 Ogwomusanvu bwava ku nkolagana wakati wa ADF ne bamukwatammundu Abasiraamu aba Al-Shabaab abasangibwa e Somalia.

items.hyp: Olw'okuba olw'okuba abantu ab'amaanyi mu by'obulimi, abantu ab'omu BDF balwanagana okwewala mu by'okwerinda.
